entries: From Middle High German entrisch (“archaic, ancient, dreadful, outrageous, egregious”), from Old High German entrisk, enterisk (“old, archaic, ancient, strange”, literally “from before, beginning-ish”), from Proto-West Germanic *andi, from Proto-Germanic *andiz (“early, before”). Related to Old High German entisk (“old”), Old Dutch endisk, entisk (“old”).
senses: causing a feeling of uneasiness; eerie, creepy, spooky; frightening
a diminutive of the female given name Magdalene
strong dative masculine/neuter singular of militant

harmless, unproblematic, unobjectionable (giving no cause for concern or reservation)
synonym of bedenkenlos: prompt, unhesitating, uncritical, unscrupulous (without concern)
